ConfirmNonce.description: Idempotency nonce required by every state-mutating endpoint. The value MUST be a UUID v4 the caller generated locally. Replays of the same nonce against the same route return the cached prior response within the nonce TTL (per-process; see internal/server/nonce.go). Missing or malformed values yield 400. Documented under gm-o9t8.14 as the canonical write-confirm header.
ConfirmNonce.name: X-GEMBA-Confirm

SpecSlug.description: Spec slug — the URL-safe identifier the spec was created with (matches `gemba spec ls` output).
SpecSlug.name: slug

WorkspaceID.description: Workspace identifier — 1:1 with a beads database (see /api/config beads_source).
WorkspaceID.name: wsid

AdaptorUnavailable.description: Adaptor is not registered or is degraded; the SPA shows a banner and keeps cached data visible.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request — invalid query parameters or body.

NotImplemented.description: Endpoint stub — wire shape is pinned but the server has not yet implemented the operation. Body carries `{ "error": { "code": "not_implemented", "message": "..." } }`.

Unsupported.description: The bound adaptor does not support this operation.

BeadsSource.description: Workspace identity — 1:1 with a beads database (gm-77u). Detail strips credentials when source is a dolt-url.

BindProjectRequest.description: Body for `POST /api/v1/projects/bind`. `mode="create"` runs `git init` at `beads_db_path` (which must equal `target_repo_path`) and writes `.gemba/workspace.toml` in place. `mode="navigate"` copies the beads DB at `beads_db_path/.beads/` into `target_repo_path/.beads/` and writes `.gemba/workspace.toml` at `target_repo_path` — `target_repo_path` must already be a git working tree.

beads_db_path.description: Absolute path to the directory holding the beads DB (the parent of the `.beads/` subdir).

target_repo_path.description: Absolute path to the directory to bind to. Equals `beads_db_path` when `mode="create"`.

CapabilitiesResponse.description: Registered transport planes plus runtime mode metadata.

CapabilityManifest.description: Subset of the manifest fields the SPA actively gates UI on. Full manifest (state_map, edge_extensions, query_languages, etc.) is documented in `core/manifest.go`; this schema captures the wire-stable boolean / version surface.

ChangeRef.description: Points into the plan tree for the most-recent skill edit. The SPA tone-codes the diff badge by `kind`. Path is slash-joined (e.g. `milestone:1/epic:0/bead:2`); empty means the change spans the whole tree.

kind.description: Labels what changed. Empty string means the skill did not categorise the change.

summary.description: Human-readable one-liner. Empty when the skill did not synthesise one.

CreateProjectRequest.description: Body for `POST /api/v1/newproject/create` — the lightweight project-creation path. No session, no Onboarder, no LLM. The server runs the same atomic ratify transaction the conversational flow uses, but with an empty Milestones[] tree (gm-root.17.13).

description.description: Optional one-or-two-line description. Mirrored into .gemba/workspace.toml and the synthesised docs/project.md.

project_name.description: Project name. Used as the directory name under default_dir.

DraftBead.description: Leaf of the plan tree. All fields are required; empty strings and zero integers are valid empty states (no missing-key surprises at ratification).

BlocksRefs.description: Intra-tree refs for beads this bead blocks.

DependsOnRefs.description: Intra-tree refs (e.g. `milestone:0/epic:1/bead:2`). Ratification resolves these to real bd-… ids in step 8a.

Type.description: One of `task` | `bug` | `feature` | `chore` today. Open string so future bead kinds do not break the SPA.

DraftEpic.description: Groups beads under a milestone in the plan tree.

DraftMilestone.description: Top-level node of the plan tree. The `type:milestone` label is added by ratification, not by the skill.

Error.description: Shared error envelope (gm-faz). `error` is a stable token the SPA branches on; `message` is human-readable and may be surfaced verbatim.

ListPersonasResponse.description: Body of `GET /api/v1/personas`. Sorted by id ascending.

NewProjectState.description: Authoritative server-side state for one new-project session. Each turn returns a fresh copy; the client replaces its local copy wholesale rather than merging diffs.

Architecture.description: Free-form architecture notes captured from the operator.

DraftProjectMD.description: Running narrative the skill keeps current each turn. Ratification persists this verbatim as `docs/project.md`.

Turn.description: Monotonic turn counter. Starts at 0; incremented on every successful turn. The ratify endpoint uses this as a stale-modal guard.

OnboarderProbeResponse.description: Body for `GET /api/v1/onboarder/probe`. Always 200; `available` is the operative signal. When `available` is false, `reason` carries the operator-facing diagnostic the SPA can surface verbatim.

available.description: True when the Onboarder persona host can resolve an LLM client (i.e. the conversational flow at /onboard would not 503).

reason.description: Operator-facing diagnostic explaining why the Onboarder is unavailable. Empty / omitted when available is true.

OnboardingSetupRequest.description: Body for `POST /api/v1/onboarding/setup`. This deterministic gate runs before any Onboarder LLM session starts.

beads_url.description: Optional mysql:// Dolt URL for the Beads database. Gas Town projects bind Beads through this URL, not through the rig directory.

gastown_location.description: Absolute Gas Town city/town root. Required when orchestration is gastown; used as cwd for gt commands.

gastown_rig.description: Optional Gas Town rig name. Defaults from project_name when omitted. Existing rigs are reused before creation.

gastown_worktree_path.description: Optional absolute path to the selected rig worktree. When omitted, setup uses gt rig list metadata or common rig-root fallbacks.

origin.description: Project source branch selected by the operator.

project_name.description: Gemba display name and local project identity.

source_analysis_tool.description: Source-analysis backend. Existing/imported codebases default to gitnexus in the SPA.

worktree_path.description: Absolute native worktree path. Required when orchestration is native.

OnboardingSetupResponse.description: Returned by `POST /api/v1/onboarding/setup` after deterministic setup completes or completes with warnings.

checks.description: Best-effort setup statuses such as git_sync, workspace, beads, source_analysis, gemba_mcp, and source_analysis_mcp.

PersonaPurview.description: gm-9rv §3 — gate authority by phase. Optional.

PersonaScopeView.description: Persona scope (gm-k2jn). `kind` is one of project / repository / any. `repository` is set iff kind=repository.

PersonaSummary.description: Operator-facing persona projection (internal/server/personas.go personaSummary). Heavy fields (system_prompt, model config, budget) are intentionally omitted.

ProjectEntry.description: One discovered project. `name` is the directory basename; `path` is the absolute disk path; `active` is true for the currently-selected project (in-process server state; resets on server restart); `kind` classifies the entry's setup state.

ProjectKind.description: Setup-state classification for a discovered project (gm-root.17.14). `complete` — has a beads DB, a `.gemba/workspace.toml`, and is inside a git repo; the picker switches to it directly. `needs_workspace` — has a beads DB but no `.gemba/workspace.toml`. `needs_repo` — has a `.gemba/workspace.toml` but is not inside a git repo. Open string at the wire so future kinds don't break clients.

ProjectsEnvelope.description: Body of `GET /api/v1/projects`. The deduped union of `default_dir` and every entry in `[projects].extra_roots` from `~/.gemba/config.toml`.

RatifyError.description: Structured error returned by `POST /api/v1/newproject/:id/ratify` when any transaction step fails. `error` is a stable machine-readable code; `step` is the 1-based transaction step that failed.

message.description: Human-readable diagnostic surfaced in the toast.

step.description: 1-based transaction step that failed (1..10; step 8a dep-resolution is encoded as 8).

RatifyRequest.description: Request body for `POST /api/v1/newproject/:id/ratify`. The server compares the submitted `state.Turn` against the live session and rejects mismatches (stale-modal guard).

RatifyResponse.description: Success envelope returned by `POST /api/v1/newproject/:id/ratify` after the 10-step transaction completes. The SPA owns post-ratify navigation (gm-root.17.7); the server returns the new project's filesystem root, its display name, and the seeded milestone / epic counts so the handoff screen can render 'seeded N milestones and M epics' without re-querying the new workspace's beads database.

epic_count.description: Number of epics created by the transaction (sum across all milestones).

milestone_count.description: Number of milestones created by the transaction.

project_name.description: Human-readable project name echoed from the ratified state.

project_path.description: Filesystem path of the new project root (default_dir/<project-name>/).

SpecKitFeature.description: One Spec Kit feature directory and the parsed artifacts Gemba can project into Beads.

SpecKitFeatureList.description: Spec Kit feature discovery result. `configured=false` means neither specs/ nor .specify/specs/ exists under the active Beads directory.

SpecKitSyncPlan.description: Read-only staged Beads reconciliation plan for one Spec Kit feature. The hash must be echoed back when applying the plan.

jsonl.description: bd-importable JSONL manifest for create/update portability.

allow_deletes.description: Must be true when the staged plan deletes stale source:spec-kit Beads.

plan_hash.description: Hash from the latest sync plan preview.

greeting.description: Optional opening line from the Onboarder. Empty string when the skill did not emit one.

session_id.description: Opaque session id used to scope subsequent /turn and /ratify calls. Lives only in server memory.

edits.description: Optional in-place edits the operator made to the plan preview pane since the last turn. Open shape — the skill interprets the path-keyed diff.

message.description: Operator message. Free text — the skill parses intent.

reply.description: Skill reply for the conversation pane. Empty when the skill updates the plan silently.

reply_id.description: Server-assigned message id for the reply (stable across re-renders).

server_version.description: Build version of the gemba server.

subject.description: Identity the credential maps to. v1 returns a static 'operator' for the single-token model; multi-identity arrives with M3 OAuth.

WorkItem.description: Subset of the WorkItem fields most commonly read by the SPA. The full shape (relationships, evidence, dod, derived signals, custom fields) is the source of truth in `core/types.go` and `web/src/types/core.gen.ts`; this schema documents the wire-stable subset for a typed client. `additionalProperties: true` keeps clients forward-compatible with fields landing in follow-up beads.

bearerToken.description: Token auth (gm-e5.1). Required when the server boots with `--auth=token`.

sessionCookie.description: Signed session cookie issued by `POST /api/auth/login` after a bearer exchange.
sessionCookie.name: gemba_session

info.description:
Wire schema for the gemba server's `/api/*` surface (gm-e4.2). The SPA at `web/` consumes a typed client generated from this document; the source of truth lives in `docs/api/openapi.json` and is served at runtime under `/api/openapi.json`.

This MVP covers the read endpoints the SPA depends on day-to-day: health, version, config, repositories, work items, sprints, agents, sessions, escalations, capabilities, and the new-project conversational flow. The remaining `/api/*` surface (consults, walks, planner, perspectives) is acknowledged in `paths` with summary-only stubs and will gain full request/response schemas in follow-up beads.

get.description:
Long-lived `text/event-stream` connection that emits Server-Sent Events as the spec reconciles. Event types (`event:` line) are:

- `bead.status` — a watched Beads issue changed status. Payload: `{ "id": "...", "status": "...", "updated_at": "..." }`.
- `spec.drift` — drift detected between spec and Beads. Payload: `{ "spec": "...", "summary": "...", "changes": [...] }`.
- `reconcile.complete` — reconcile run finished. Payload: `{ "run_id": "...", "applied": true|false, "errors": [...] }`.

Each event is `\n\n`-terminated; clients tolerate keep-alive comments (`: ping`). Stub: 501 until gm-v0sp.

schema.description: Decoded event payload (the `data:` line of a single SSE frame). The frame's `event:` line is one of `bead.status`, `spec.drift`, or `reconcile.complete`; concrete payload fields vary per type — see endpoint description.
